rationale: With 0.5 h intervals the critical load totals 15.5 kWh. EV discharge commands are limited to dispatch_step grid (ev_a: 0/4/8 kW; ev_b: 0/3/6 kW) and to each battery's usable margin above reserve (ev_a 8 kWh, ev_b 8 kWh). The best feasible grid schedule draws 8 kWh from ev_a (ending exactly at its 16 kWh reserve) and 7.5 kWh from ev_b (ending at 12.5 kWh), for 15.5 kWh of battery energy. At 0.9 discharge efficiency this delivers 13.95 kWh to the critical-load bus. Per-interval bus powers 4.5, 4.95 and 4.5 kWh stay within the 5, 6 and 4.5 kWh load caps, so no curtailment occurs.
